gates.name: External Neon quota and account-owner decision
gates.assessment: The live billing plan, exhausted quota counter, current-period usage and reset time are not available through the connected read-only sources. Account-owner decision is required.

gates.name: PostgreSQL connection recovery
gates.assessment: Blocked until the account owner has resolved or deliberately deferred the quota condition and PostgreSQL accepts connections again.

gates.name: Successful Railway production redeployment
gates.assessment: No production redeployment is authorized by this snapshot. A terminal successful deployment must be bound to the exact deployed commit.

gates.name: Application migration and readiness verification
gates.assessment: A successful image build or deployment state alone is insufficient; Flyway validation/application and the readiness probe must be recorded.

gates.name: Production smoke and post-deployment verification
gates.assessment: Recovery remains unproven until the documented production smoke checks and an observed post-deployment result are recorded.

assessment: The incident is blocked by an external Neon quota condition. All five recovery gates remain unverified; this registry is a machine-checked gate contract, not evidence that recovery has occurred.
